Pathweft native archive runtime

7-Zip 26.05, Copyright (C) 1999-2026 Igor Pavlov.
https://www.7-zip.org/
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.05

The official Windows x64 installer is inspected as an archive to obtain 7z.dll;
it is never installed or executed by Pathweft. Runtime uses the DLL's COM API,
not 7z.exe or a separate archive GUI. Native/source digests and DLL identity are
recorded in runtime-manifest.json. Complete matching native source is available
as the pinned official 7z2605-src.tar.xz release asset.

Preserve LICENSE.txt, including LGPL-2.1-or-later, BSD and unRAR restrictions.
The final delivery stage owns complete matching source/notices and actual
delivered dependency verification. No native donor binary is included in Git.
